fusions.name: Cutting Crescent
fusions.desc: Cuts a target at or below 30% health for 16 damage, consuming every affliction on it for 1.4 times their remaining damage. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4s after you use it.

fusions.name: Scything Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 4 tiles long that deals 4 damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Windfall Mend
fusions.desc: Restores 20 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every tenth of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Reaped Momentum
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
